title: SourceProviderConfig
description:
Config node for a filesystem-backed SourceProvider.

Points at a directory of source files and selects which of them
are exposed via get_sources_list()/get_source().

path.title: Path
path.description: Root directory to scan for source files. Must exist at validation time.

file_masks.title: File Masks
file_masks.description: Glob patterns (fnmatch-style, via Path.match) used to filter files found under 'path'. A file is included if it matches ANY mask. Defaults to ['*'] (all files).
